newsitem.title: ANTIGUA AND BARBUDA: CRICKET-LEEWARD ISLANDS WIN TOSS, PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LEEWARD ISLANDS WIN TOSS, PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.

text.p: The Leeward Islands won the toss and put Sri Lanka in to bat on the opening day of their three-day match on Sunday:
Leeward Islands - Dave Joseph (captain), Angello Bass, Junie Mitchum, Alex Adams, Runako Morton, Stuart Williams, Ridley Jacobs, Warrington Phillip, Lesroy Irish, Whitmore Quinn, Mickey Mills.

Sri Lanka - Aravinda de Silva (captain), Russell Arnold, Roshan Mahanama, Maravan Atapattu, Sanjeeva Ranatunga, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Dilip Liyanage, Muttiah Muralitharan, Ravindra Pushpakumara.
